# Changelog

- **v3.4**: `Keyline-Retry-Token` on the token endpoint. Device-code grant GA.
- **v3.3**: `Keyline-Version` header. `session.suspicious` webhook.
- **v3.2**: Token-family reuse detection enabled for all tenants. Session limits.
- **v3.1**: Webhooks for `session.revoked`, `user.locked`, `password.changed`.
- **v3.0**: Tenant-scoped URLs. Absolute refresh-token lifetime. Password grant
  deprecated for new clients.
